//: Type-checks the TypeScript samples in README.md against the real SDK.
A sample that references a method or type the SDK no longer exports is a
compile error here, which is the whole point: prose can be wrong quietly,
`paths` maps the published package name onto the local source, so the
samples can be written exactly as a consumer would write them rather than
with relative imports no reader would ever type.
Run with: npm run typecheck:samples (extracts the samples first).
